script.title: Piplup — A Very Proud Little Wave
script.description: A large freestanding Piplup waving one flipper: a rounded navy crown, azure cheek masks, sparkling inset eyes, a smiling yellow beak, twin white chest spots and individually shaped webbed toes. Bonded hollow construction keeps its oversized head light.
